title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Saturday, November 7, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
NYC today: cooler, with a high near 60°F after yesterday's heavy rain. It starts sunny, then clouds build. There's a small chance of a passing afternoon or evening shower, mostly north of the city. I couldn't get a live current temperature or an exact low, so check your weather app before heading out. Sunday looks brighter and breezy.
👕 What to wear: layers and a light jacket. Pack a compact umbrella if you're heading north.

🗞️ Headlines
• Strong jobs report: the U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, well above forecasts, and unemployment is 4.1%.
• Markets: chip stocks bounced back Friday after Thursday's AI selloff, the worst day since April 2025. All three major indexes still ended the week lower.
• Midterm aftermath: Democrats celebrate a wave. Some incoming Democratic senators say they won't back Chuck Schumer for leader, and the House could vote on articles of impeachment as early as next week.
• NYC: voters passed all five Mamdani-backed ballot measures, which cover bus and bike lanes, outdoor dining, city contracting and the rainy day fund. Separately, an appeals panel is letting the city resume collecting its tax on luxury second homes.
• World: Pope Leo XIV begins a Latin America tour in Uruguay, three weeks after lung cancer surgery. A judge also blocked construction of Trump's arch right after it got federal approval.

🚇 Getting around
• J/M: no service between Myrtle Av in Brooklyn and Manhattan this weekend because of switch work. Use the L, or the A/C/F, to cross.
• 1: trains bypass 125 St through mid-December for viaduct repairs.
• Check the MTA app before you ride, since weekend plans can change.

🎉 NYC today
• The 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas tree is due to arrive at Rockefeller Plaza today, ahead of its December lighting.
• Diwali celebrations are happening around the city this weekend.

💡 Nugget
Now that the clocks have fallen back, sunset is around 4:45 PM. Get your daylight errands, run or park time done early this afternoon.
